verdictMeaning: A family chooses a jacal, a round-log cabin, a hewn-log cabin or a dog-run, sees what each needs, the hours of work, how many it holds, how rest mends and how food keeps in it before choosing, and can change its mind until work begins. Anybody old enough can be set to one chore, Work on the house, which keeps going until the house stands; several people work at once and more hands finish sooner. When it stands, everybody on it stops, the family has a roof, and the house acts through rest at home and food spoiling, with crowding for a family bigger than it holds. A neighbour's land is known as it was last seen. A class saved before this keeps its cabin at the ordinary rate and nothing spoiling; no save version moved.
implementation: sim/houses.mjs (HOUSES, planRefusal/planHouse, buildRefusal/buildSpell, stageOf, shelterOf, houseProjection, noteLandSeen/landView, houseInvalid, houseCatalogue); sim/chores.mjs (build-house chore, houseWork/build steps, all workers finished on the last spell, house work omitted for a settled family); sim/routines.mjs reads shelterOf; sim/world.mjs (plan-house action and LOBBY_ACTIONS, noteLandSeen after arrivals, land projection, validation); server/app.mjs (/api/chores houses); public/ (#house-plan panel and #house-open button, land line, homesteadHouse stand-ins, neighbour land from seenLand); tests/chores.test.mjs accounts for the omitted house chore.
timings: Default family of four, all set to work on arrival (seeds house-a/b/c): jacal 15 ticks, round-log 25, hewn-log 39, dog-run 71 - the dog-run finishing at tick 80 against the notice at 84. A lone parent (proof below) took about 220 ticks for a round-log cabin.
